issues.explanation: Chapter 41 says Zhao Yun ultimately breaks through the encirclement, then immediately says he is intercepted again by Zhong Jin and Zhong Shen. The source presents this as a continuing sequence of successive obstacles, so “最终突围” prematurely implies the escape is complete before the handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace “最终突围” with “一路杀退曹军” or “仍在突围途中”，then retain the interception by Zhong Jin and Zhong Shen.
